finding.title: Demo service is listening and answers unauthenticated clients
finding.description: Port 7788 accepts a connection and greets it without asking for credentials. Anything that reaches the port can talk to the service.
finding.remediation: Bind the service to localhost or put it behind an authenticated proxy, and restrict the port at the firewall.

finding.title: A database dump is downloadable from the web root
finding.description: GET /backup.sql returns a SQL dump. Anyone who can reach the site can take the database, including whatever it holds in clear text.
finding.remediation: Remove the dump from the document root and check the access log for who fetched it.
